name: How do I manage daily meals while my kitchen is under construction?

mainEntity.name: How do I manage daily meals while my kitchen is under construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting up an alternative cooking station keeps your household functional during construction. Move your microwave, coffee maker, and a toaster oven or electric skillet to an adjacent room with safe electrical capacity, such as a dining room or basement wet bar. Set aside paper plates and disposables, or designate a bathroom or utility sink for washing basic dishes. Relocate your refrigerator nearby before demolition begins so your family maintains easy access to fresh food throughout the remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Set up a temporary meal station in an adjacent room with a microwave, mini-fridge, and basic essentials to keep your household running during demolition.
